Integrations/Developer

Coinbase Agents MCP

Coinbase Agents MCP lets authorized agents inspect portfolios, accounts, products, fees, orders, fills, and market data, and perform permitted conversions, trades, transfers, portfolio changes, and x402 payments.

29 actionsAPI key

Connect Coinbase Agents MCP

What your bot can do in Coinbase Agents MCP

Looks up

  • Coinbase balanceReturns account balances for exactly one portfolio.
  • Coinbase convert getCheck status of a conversion by quote ID.
  • Coinbase feesFee tier, maker/taker rates, and 30-day volume.
  • Coinbase orders edit previewEstimate the result, fees, fill price, and slippage of changing an open order's size or limit price without editing it.
  • Coinbase orders fillsLists individual trade executions with commissions and maker/taker indicator, filterable by product, order, side, and time range.
  • Coinbase orders getRetrieves the full status and fill details of a single order by ID.
  • Coinbase orders listLists orders with optional filters by status, product, side, and time range.
  • Coinbase orders previewEstimate fees, fill price, slippage, and execution plans without placing an order.
  • Coinbase portfolios getReturns portfolio metadata, balances, and positions.
  • Coinbase portfolios listLists all portfolios on the account, including their UUIDs and types.
Show 7 more
  • Coinbase products best bid askReturns best bid and ask for one or more products in a single call.
  • Coinbase products bookReturns the current bid/ask order book for a product.
  • Coinbase products candlesReturns historical OHLCV candles for a product at a chosen granularity and time range.
  • Coinbase products getViewing a product, including a FUTURE one, doesn't require any special account approval.
  • Coinbase products listViewing products, including FUTURE ones, doesn't require any special account approval.
  • Coinbase products tickerReturns recent trade prints plus the current best bid/ask for a product.
  • Coinbase x402 resourcesDiscover curated x402 resources.

Takes action

  • Coinbase convert executeExecutes a previously quoted conversion using the quote_id from convert_quote.
  • Coinbase convert quoteQuotes stablecoin↔fiat and stablecoin↔stablecoin conversions, returning rate, fees, and a quote ID.
  • Coinbase orders cancelCancels one or more open orders by ID.
  • Coinbase orders close positionPlaces a market order to flatten an open position for a product, moving funds immediately.
  • Coinbase orders createPlace a market, limit, stop_limit, bracket, twap, or scaled order, subject to venue eligibility.
  • Coinbase orders editAtomically update an open order's price or size without cancelling.
  • Coinbase portfolios createCreates a new named portfolio for segregating funds and positions.
  • Coinbase portfolios deletePermanently deletes a portfolio.
  • Coinbase portfolios editRenames an existing portfolio.
  • Coinbase transferMoves funds of a single currency from one portfolio to another.
